name: cache-tax
description: A Claude Code mod that keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

pingPeriodMinutes.title: Ping period (minutes)
pingPeriodMinutes.description: Minutes between keep-warm pings, 1 to 59. The cache lives one hour, so keep it under that.

windowHours.title: Window (hours)
windowHours.description: Default keep-warm window in hours, up to 168. With always on, each turn rolls the window forward to this long.
